title: Add cook mode launch controls in recipe detail
description: Add the `Cook now` action to the recipe detail bottom bar and wire full-screen presentation state from `RecipeDetailSheet`, including the no-steps gating rule and passing the locked scale into cook mode.
acceptance_criteria: `RecipeBottomBar` exposes a `Cook now` action alongside the existing bottom-bar actions.
The action is disabled or otherwise suppressed when the parsed recipe has no `.step` content across sections.
`RecipeDetailSheet` presents cook mode via `.fullScreenCover` and passes the parsed recipe plus current scale into the new flow.

handoff_summary.completed: - RecipeBottomBar: added `onCookNow: () -> Void` parameter, `hasSteps` computed property (mirrors StepsView logic — checks for `.step` content across all sections), and a `Cook now` / `play.fill` button that is disabled when `!hasSteps`. Accessibility label and hint wired. Preview updated.\n- RecipeDetailSheet: added `@State private var showCookMode = false`, passed `onCookNow: { showCookMode = true }` to RecipeBottomBar, and appended `.fullScreenCover(isPresented: $showCookMode) { CookModeView(recipe: recipe.recipe, scale: currentScale) }` after the existing sheets.\n- CookModeView.swift: new stub with `init(recipe: Recipe, scale: RecipeScale)`, a Close toolbar button, and a NavigationStack shell. Marked as placeholder for B-09ce3e88.
handoff_summary.remaining: B-09ce3e88 must implement the full CookModeView (gather phase, session state, idle-timer lifecycle). The stub file I created will be replaced.
handoff_summary.risks: CookModeView stub has a fixed init signature (recipe + scale). If B-09ce3e88 lands a different initialiser, RecipeDetailSheet's fullScreenCover call will need a follow-up update. Confirmed disjoint expected_files so no merge conflict between this bead and B-09ce3e88.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify: Cook now button visible in RecipeBottomBar, disabled on recipe with no steps, enabled on recipe with steps; tapping opens fullScreenCover with CookModeView stub; existing Add to meal plan and Add to shopping list actions unaffected.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: CookModeView.swift is also in B-09ce3e88's expected_files. When B-09ce3e88 runs it will overwrite the stub — no structural conflict, but if the init signature diverges from (recipe: Recipe, scale: RecipeScale) then RecipeDetailSheet will need a patch.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used `play.fill` SF Symbol for Cook now — semantically conveys "start" without cooking-specific iconography (no SF Symbol for cooking is as universally recognisable). Button placed as third item in the existing HStack to maintain visual parity with the other two actions. The `hasSteps` logic is a direct copy of StepsView's `hasAnyStep` to keep the gating rule in sync.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Visual aspects (button layout, disabled state appearance, fullScreenCover transition) require manual verification. Unit-testable: hasSteps logic can be exercised by constructing Recipe values with and without .step content.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: CookModeView.swift is a non-functional stub. The fullScreenCover will open a placeholder screen until B-09ce3e88 delivers the real implementation.

conflict_risks: CookModeView.swift is also in B-09ce3e88's expected_files. When B-09ce3e88 runs it will overwrite the stub — no structural conflict, but if the init signature diverges from (recipe: Recipe, scale: RecipeScale) then RecipeDetailSheet will need a patch.

execution_history.summary: Added `Cook now` launch controls to RecipeBottomBar and wired full-screen presentation in RecipeDetailSheet. Created a minimal CookModeView stub so the project compiles; B-09ce3e88 will replace it with the full implementation.
